@@U04049@@
Me? No, you. This time you're the commander-in-chief.

@@U04051@@
And wouldn't that be something! Ordering about in a language I don't even know!

@@U04053@@
Leave that to your General Staff and you're home free. Now, knowing the mess that war can be, I’ve anticipated and formed a war council out of mountain manpower as old as earth. He’s a lucky man who can get them in harness.

@@U04055@@
‘

@@U04056@@
Who are those armed men there? Have you stirred up the mountain folk?

@@U04058@@
No, but, like Peter Quince, the very quintessence of the rabble.

@@U04059@@
(Enter THREE VIOLENT GIANTS.)

@@U04061@@
Ah, here come my boys now! As you will note, they differ widely in age, clothing and the arms they wear. I think you'll find they'll serve you well.

@@U04062@@
(To the audience.)

@@U04063@@
Everyone these days delights seeing knights in armor; and since these brutes are allegorical, they'll just likely manage to please all the more.
translation:
@@U04049@@
我？不，你。这次你是总司令。

@@U04051@@
那不会是什么东西吧！用我什至不知道的语言订购！

@@U04053@@
把它交给你的总参谋部，你就可以回家了。现在，在了解战争可能造成的混乱之后，我已经预料到并由与地球一样古老的山地人力组成了一个战争委员会。他是一个幸运的人，能够把它们绑在安全带上。

@@U04055@@
'

@@U04056@@
那里的那些武装人员是谁？你把山里人都搅动了吗？

@@U04058@@
不，但是，就像彼得·昆斯一样，他是乌合之众的精髓。

@@U04059@@
（三个暴力巨人上。）

@@U04061@@
啊，我的孩子们现在来了！正如您将注意到的，他们在年龄、服装和佩戴的手臂上差异很大。我想你会发现他们会很好地为你服务。

@@U04062@@
（对观众。）

@@U04063@@
如今，每个人都喜欢看到身穿盔甲的骑士；由于这些野兽是寓言性的，他们很可能会设法取悦更多人。
